name: Ebony Spleenwort
desc: Ebony Spleenwort (Asplenium platyneuron): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asplenium platyneuron, commonly known as ebony spleenwort or brownstem spleenwort, is a fern native to North America east of the Rocky Mountains and to South Africa.
